question: What is the total revenue?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(total) FROM orders;

question: How many customers do we have?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers;

question: What is the average order value?
gold_sql: SELECT AVG(total) FROM orders;

question: What is the maximum customer ID?
gold_sql: SELECT MAX(id) FROM customers;

question: What is the minimum order date?
gold_sql: SELECT MIN(date) FROM orders;

question: Count distinct products ordered.
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT product_id) FROM orders;

question: Sum revenue by product.
gold_sql: SELECT product_id, SUM(total) FROM orders GROUP BY product_id;

question: List all customers.
gold_sql: SELECT * FROM customers;

question: Count orders per customer.
gold_sql: SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id;

question: What is total revenue per month?
gold_sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', date), SUM(total) FROM orders GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', date);

question: Show top 5 customers by revenue.
gold_sql: SELECT c.id, c.name, SUM(o.total) as revenue FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 5;

question: List customers with their order count.
gold_sql: SELECT c.name, COUNT(o.id) FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.id, c.name;

question: Join customers and orders, show all matches.
gold_sql: SELECT c.name, o.total FROM customers c INNER JOIN orders o ON c.id = o.customer_id;

question: Show products ordered by each customer.
gold_sql: SELECT c.name, p.name FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id;

question: Find customers who ordered each product.
gold_sql: SELECT p.name, c.name FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.id;

question: Get total by customer with product info.
gold_sql: SELECT c.name, p.name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id GROUP BY c.id, c.name, p.id, p.name;

question: Show revenue per customer and product.
gold_sql: SELECT c.id, p.id, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) as revenue FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id GROUP BY c.id, p.id;

question: List all orders with customer names.
gold_sql: SELECT o.id, c.name, o.total FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.id;

question: Compare 2024 vs 2023 revenue.
gold_sql: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date), SUM(total) FROM orders WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date) IN (2023, 2024) GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date);

question: Year-over-year sales growth.
gold_sql: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date) as year, SUM(total) as revenue FROM orders GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date) ORDER BY year;

question: Revenue this quarter vs last quarter.
gold_sql: SELECT EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM date) as quarter, SUM(total) FROM orders WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date) = 2024 GROUP BY EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM date);

question: Orders in the last 30 days.
gold_sql: SELECT * FROM orders WHERE date >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days';

question: Compare Q1 2024 revenue to Q1 2023.
gold_sql: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date), SUM(total) FROM orders WHERE EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM date) = 1 GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date);

question: Monthly revenue trends for 2024.
gold_sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', date), SUM(total) FROM orders WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date) = 2024 GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', date) ORDER BY DATE_TRUNC('month', date);

question: Top 5 customers by revenue.
gold_sql: SELECT c.id, c.name, SUM(o.total) as revenue FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 5;

question: Revenue in the last month.
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(total) FROM orders WHERE date >= NOW() - INTERVAL '1 month';

question: Top products.
gold_sql: SELECT p.id, p.name, SUM(oi.quantity) as units_sold FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON p.id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY units_sold DESC;

question: Growth rate.

question: Best-selling products in 2024.
gold_sql: SELECT p.id, p.name, SUM(oi.quantity) as units FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.date) = 2024 GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY units DESC;

question: Customers who bought in 2023 and 2024.
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.id, c.name FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.date) IN (2023, 2024);

question: Average order value by customer segment.
gold_sql: SELECT c.segment, AVG(o.total) FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.segment;

question: Revenue from repeat customers.
gold_sql: SELECT c.id, c.name, SUM(o.total) FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE c.id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) GROUP BY c.id, c.name;

question: Most expensive orders by customer.
gold_sql: SELECT c.name, o.id, o.total FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.id = o.customer_id ORDER BY c.id, o.total DESC;

question: How has revenue trended over the years?
gold_sql: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date) as year, SUM(total) as revenue FROM orders GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date) ORDER BY year;

question: Which quarter had the highest revenue?
gold_sql: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date), EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM date), SUM(total) FROM orders GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date), EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM date) ORDER BY SUM(total) DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Daily revenue for last week.
gold_sql: SELECT DATE(date), SUM(total) FROM orders WHERE date >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' GROUP BY DATE(date) ORDER BY DATE(date);

question: Week-over-week growth this year.
gold_sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('week', date), SUM(total) FROM orders WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date) = 2024 GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('week', date) ORDER BY DATE_TRUNC('week', date);

question: Average items per order.
gold_sql: SELECT AVG(item_count) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) as item_count FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id);

question: Total revenue by order status.
gold_sql: SELECT status, SUM(total) FROM orders GROUP BY status;

question: Percentage of orders by status.
gold_sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders) FROM orders GROUP BY status;

question: Customers with no orders.
gold_sql: SELECT c.id, c.name FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.id IS NULL;

question: Products never ordered.
gold_sql: SELECT p.id, p.name FROM products p LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE oi.id IS NULL;
